 1499    /// (<see cref="OrderDataFilterManager.NormalizeArticleForSearch"/>): Orders.Article может
 1500    /// содержать дефисы/пробелы, которых нет в артикуле снэпшота 1С — точное сравнение их теряет.

 1503    internal static async Task<Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, int>>> LoadOrderReservesAsync(
 1504        ApplicationDbContext db,
 1505        IReadOnlyList<int> reservedStatusIds,
 1506        CancellationToken ct)
 1507    {
 01508        var result = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, int>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 01509        if (reservedStatusIds.Count == 0) return result;
 1510
 01511        var rows = await db.Orders
 01512            .Where(o => o.Article != null
 01513                     && o.OrderArchive == null
 01514                     && o.AppStatusId.HasValue
 01515                     && reservedStatusIds.Contains(o.AppStatusId.Value))
 01516            .Select(o => new {
 01517                o.Article,
 01518                o.ProductKey,
 01519                o.Quantity,
 01520                WarehouseName = o.ShipmentWarehouse != null ? o.ShipmentWarehouse.Name : null,
 01521                ZasylValue = o.OrderExtensions
 01522                    .Where(e => e.Key == "Засыл")
 01523                    .Select(e => e.Value)
 01524                    .FirstOrDefault()
 01525            })
 01526            .ToListAsync(ct);
 1527
 01528        foreach (var row in rows)
 1529        {
 01530            var normalizedArticle = OrderDataFilterManager.NormalizeArticleForSearch(row.Article);
 01531            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(normalizedArticle)) continue;
 01532            var warehouseName = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(row.WarehouseName)
 01533                ? row.WarehouseName
 01534                : row.ZasylValue;
 01535            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(warehouseName)) continue;
 1536
 01537            var qty = row.Quantity ?? 1;
 01538            var m = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(row.ProductKey ?? "", @"\[(\d+)\]");
 01539            if (m.Success && int.TryParse(m.Groups[1].Value, out var mult) && mult > 1)
 01540                qty *= mult;

 01542            if (!result.TryGetValue(normalizedArticle, out var storeMap))
 01543                result[normalizedArticle] = storeMap = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 01544            storeMap.TryGetValue(warehouseName, out var cur);
 01545            storeMap[warehouseName] = cur + qty;
 1546        }
 01547        return result;
 01548    }

 01731        });

 02073            foreach (var reportId in toDelete)

 02082                }
 02083            }
 02084            return toDelete.Count;
 02085        }, cancellationToken);

 2432    private static async Task SaveOzonPriceSnapshotsAsync(
 2433        ApplicationDbContext db,

 2450            {

 2472    private static void EnrichOzonPriceItem(JToken item)
 2473    {
 02474        var commissions = item["commissions"];
 02475        var priceObj    = item["price"] as JObject;
 02476        if (commissions == null || priceObj == null) return;
 2477
 02478        decimal salesPercent    = commissions["sales_percent_fbs"]?.Value<decimal>()             ?? 0;
 02479        decimal itemPrice       = priceObj["price"]?.Value<decimal>()                             ?? 0;
 02480        decimal acquiring       = item["acquiring"]?.Value<decimal>()                             ?? 0;
 02481        decimal fbsFirstMileMin = commissions["fbs_first_mile_min_amount"]?.Value<decimal>()     ?? 0;
 02482        decimal fbsFirstMileMax = commissions["fbs_first_mile_max_amount"]?.Value<decimal>()     ?? 0;
 02483        decimal fbsDirectMin    = commissions["fbs_direct_flow_trans_min_amount"]?.Value<decimal>() ?? 0;
 02484        decimal fbsDirectMax    = commissions["fbs_direct_flow_trans_max_amount"]?.Value<decimal>() ?? 0;
 02485        decimal fboDeliv        = commissions["fbo_deliv_to_customer_amount"]?.Value<decimal>()  ?? 0;
 2486
 02487        decimal ozonReward    = itemPrice * salesPercent / 100;
 02488        decimal maxCommission = ozonReward + acquiring + fbsFirstMileMax + fbsDirectMax + fboDeliv;
 02489        decimal minCommission = ozonReward + acquiring + fbsFirstMileMin + fbsDirectMin + fboDeliv;
 02490        double  marketingPrice = priceObj["marketing_seller_price"]?.Value<double>() ?? 0;
 02491        double  truePrice      = marketingPrice * 0.91;
 2492
 02493        priceObj["max_commission"] = Math.Round(maxCommission, 2);
 02494        priceObj["min_commission"] = Math.Round(minCommission, 2);
 02495        priceObj["ozon_reward"]    = Math.Round(ozonReward, 2);
 02496        priceObj["true_price"]     = Math.Round(truePrice, 2);
 02497    }
